verdict.rationale: Datalab documents a webhooks feature. You configure a default webhook URL to get real-time notifications when document-processing jobs complete, replacing polling, and you can override that URL per request with the webhook_url parameter. Programmatic consumers can register and receive these HTTP callbacks. Missing for 10: any documented event type beyond job completion, payload, signing and retry details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks provide real-time notifications when your document processing jobs complete, eliminating the need for continuous polling.
Configure webhooks to receive real-time notifications when Datalab jobs complete.
You can override the default webhook URL for specific API requests by including the webhook_url parameter
